title: hieracium vulgatum subsp. tortifolium
intro: Hieracium vulgatum subsp. tortifolium, commonly known as the Rough Hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the management of fever. The therapeutic actions of Rough Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant properties, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
